Name: Highest
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Highest, command: one)
WITH max(id) AS highest SELECT highest FROM readings;
Template: WITH max(id) AS highest SELECT ⟨c0:highest⟩ FROM readings;

Name: Scaled
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Scaled, command: many)
WITH 2 AS factor SELECT factor * id AS scaled, id + 1 AS following FROM readings WHERE id > factor;
Template: WITH 2 AS factor SELECT ⟨c0 aliased:factor * id⟩ AS scaled, ⟨c1 aliased:id + 1⟩ AS following FROM readings WHERE id > factor;

Name: Bounded
SQL:
-- sgl.query(name: Bounded, command: many)
WITH {limit:UInt32} AS bound SELECT id FROM readings WHERE id < bound;
Template: WITH ⟨p0 UInt32⟩ AS bound SELECT ⟨c0:id⟩ FROM readings WHERE id < bound;⟨arguments p0⟩
